selected.text: The raptures of my longing for Thee and the fragrances of Thy raiment have so seized me that patience and composure have departed from me
selected.reason: A prayer honestly voices the loss of composure in longing, balancing passages about inward rest.

selected.text: The limbs of existence have trembled with the fear of God, yet the people understand not.
selected.reason: Reverent fear adds a distinct spiritual response beyond joy and attraction.

selected.text: Blessed is the eye that no veils of names nor clouds cast by the people of creation prevented from beholding the Most Exalted Horizon.
selected.reason: Names and social impressions can veil perception of the divine horizon.

selected.text: be made ready in Our presence, that it may be sent. Be ye thankful though ye have not partaken, and render praise though ye have not seen. This station is one intended and worthy of regard. Verily, He is the best of those who
selected.reason: Gratitude is encouraged even without seeing or directly partaking of a gift.

selected.text: But if a sanctified eye would turn away from the ashes of vain imaginings, it would behold the Daystar of this Revelation shining resplendently above the highest peaks of the mountain of true understanding.
selected.reason: True understanding requires turning away from the residue of imagination.

selected.text: If you comprehend this bounty and become aware of it, you will manifest such joy and gladness that the cares and sorrows of this ephemeral realm will not affect it.
selected.reason: Awareness of bounty is connected with joy that survives passing cares.

selected.text: Today you should be so carried away by the sweet savors of the divine verses and the fragrances of the robe of the All-Merciful that no sorrow can overtake you. The source of sorrow is heedlessness of the Truth, and the wellspring of joy is faith in the Self of the Manifestation.
selected.reason: A direct explanation identifies recognition and faith as the wellspring of spiritual joy.

selected.text: those who have been enkindled with the fire of God and have attained to His love are not veiled by trials. Rather, the more severe the trials become, the more their fire of love surges forth.
selected.reason: Trials test and can intensify love rather than necessarily extinguishing it.

selected.text: This letter was written in the Hijazi melody and sent forth, and this writing is cast in the Persian tongue so that thou mayest hear the sweet songs of the soul from the divine nightingale and receive the wondrous melodies of the Beloved from the spiritual bird
selected.reason: The relation between language, melody and meaning appears in an explicitly bilingual letter.

selected.text: The fire of my heedlessness has burned me - where is the fountain of Thy grace, O Beloved of those in the heavens and earth? The hosts of vain imaginings have weakened me - where is the dawning of the Sun of Thy knowledge, O Worshipped One of the sincere?
selected.reason: A prayer acknowledges heedlessness and imagination while seeking grace and knowledge.

selected.text: Otherwise, in days of glory when the breezes of divine power are passing by, all have claimed and will claim to love the Beauty of the All-Glorious. But that claim depends upon another test, for it is not known whether the cause was outward circumstances or the Divine Spirit itself.
selected.reason: Claims of love are tested to distinguish spiritual motive from favorable outward circumstances.

selected.text: Be thou patient in separation and be not distressed within thyself, and be of them that are patient. Then beseech God that He may bring about a reunion between us and you
selected.reason: Patience in separation accompanies prayer for reunion rather than suppressing longing.

selected.text: Blessed is he who loves the world simply for the sake of the face of his generous Lord.
selected.reason: Love of the world for the sake of God qualifies language of detachment from it.

selected.text: We perceived from it the fragrance of thy turning, thy devotion, thy humility and thy submissiveness to this Cause whereby the feet of the mystics have slipped. Blessed be thy tongue, for it hath spoken the truth; and thy face, for it hath turned toward the lights of the Countenance; and thy heart, for it hath turned to the One, the All-Informed.
selected.reason: Devotion, humility and receptivity are brought together in a fuller spiritual portrait.

selected.text: listen to their words with spirituality and humility … O pure and gentle hearts
selected.reason: Listening with humility connects receptivity to respectful encounter with others.

selected.text: Verily, I read thy recent letter which showed thy strong love, thy being ablaze with the fire of the love of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Praised, and the penetration of the Spirit of Truth in thy limbs, nerves, veins, arteries, bones, blood and flesh, until it hath taken the reins of power from thy hands and moveth thee as it willeth, causeth thee to speak in what it willeth and attracted thee as it willeth. This is becoming of whatever heart is replenished with the spirit of the love of God.
selected.original: Verily, I read thy recent letter which showed thy strong love, thy being ablaze with the fire of the love of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Praised, and the penetration of the Spirit of Truth in thy limbs, nerves, veins, arteries, bones, blood and flesh, until it hath taken the reins of power from thy hands and moveth thee as it willeth, causeth thee to speak in what it willeth and attracted thee as it willeth. This is becoming of whatever heart is replenished with the spirit of the love of God.   AB01860
